# fonts

Fonts: IBM Plex Sans for the UI (IBM's face for technical, instrument-like interfaces; its Light cut is the thin sans for annotations), JetBrains Mono Nerd Font for terminals and the bar, Noto for coverage and emoji.

They are not part of the palette.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`fonts/packages`): `inter-font` (the previous UI face, unused (IBM Plex Sans replaced it): sudo pacman -Rns inter-font, then drop this line), `ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd` (mono (terminal, bar)), `noto-fonts`, `noto-fonts-cjk`, `noto-fonts-emoji`, `ttf-dejavu`, `ttf-ibm-plex`, `ttf-ibmplex-mono-nerd`, `ttf-liberation`, `ttf-nerd-fonts-symbols`, `ttf-nerd-fonts-symbols-mono`, `ttf-terminus-nerd`
